headline: ECB raises rates 25bp to 2.25% deposit facility
summary: The European Central Bank raised its deposit facility rate by 25 basis points from 2.00% to 2.25% on 11 June 2026, citing eurozone inflation at 3.2% in May 2026 driven largely by Iran-war-related energy price increases.

headline: Canada CPI (July 2026) comes in above forecast
summary: Canada headline CPI rose 3.0% y/y in July 2026, above the 2.9% forecast (previous: 2.8%); core CPI rose 2.3% y/y vs 2.2% forecast. Gasoline prices were the primary driver.
source_note: Verified via WebFetch during setup — secondary forex-news aggregation of the underlying StatCan release, dated one day before this test. Credibility set lower than the ECB/Euronews entry since it's a market recap, not the primary statistical agency release.

headline: Japan Q2 2026 GDP misses forecast
summary: Japan's Q2 2026 annualized GDP growth came in at 1.1% y/y, below the 1.9% forecast (previous: 1.8%) — softer-than-expected growth, though the yen still firmed as traders focused on fading Fed rate-hike expectations.
source_note: Verified via WebFetch during setup — secondary forex-news aggregation, same caveat as the CAD entry above. Note the market reaction (yen firming) diverged from the pure data reading (GDP miss = bearish) because of a competing driver (US rate expectations) — a reminder that PESTLE-only scoring won't always match spot price action.
